en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street leading to a medieval brick church and adjoining buildings. The central structure has a large pointed gable with an arched entrance and circular window above, flanked by Gothic windows and buttresses. A chapel with a small cross-topped roof and a square tower with belfry openings are visible. On the left is a row of townhouses; in the foreground is a low fence with vegetation. Printed caption text appears at the top in French, and a handwritten signature is on the right margin.
